description:
Open Ephemeris gives ChatGPT real astronomy to work from. Every position comes from the NASA JPL DE440 ephemeris covering 1550-2650 CE at sub-arcsecond precision, the same kernel used for spacecraft navigation, so positions are computed rather than estimated.

Ask for a natal chart and an interactive wheel opens in the conversation. Click a planet, a house, or an aspect line and the interpretation loads in place. Switch house systems without asking again. The same applies to Human Design bodygraphs, synastry bi-wheels, transit timelines, Vedic Rashi grids and BaZi Four Pillars charts.

Beyond charts: transits and progressions, solar and lunar returns, eclipse timing and local visibility, astrocartography, electional search for timing windows, and fixed-star positions.

Free to start, no card required.

defaultPrompt: Make me an interactive natal chart for July 20, 1969 at 8:17 PM in Houston, Texas.
Show me the Human Design bodygraph for someone born January 15, 1990 at 10:00 AM in London.
What's the moon phase right now, and when is the next full moon?
